instruction: Stack the three blocks with different textures.

arguments.note: The three blocks are on the right side. I will turn the right gripper downward to pick and stack them, leaving the left arm at home.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 16 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The first rotation landed exactly. I will finish orienting straight down for a clear overhead grasp.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 15 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will approach the purple block from above, using the downward wrist view to refine its position before closing.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The approach landed within a millimetre. I will center over the purple block and lower to a short distance above its top.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The purple block is centered laterally. I will bring the jaws toward its center while keeping them just above the block.

arguments.note: The jaws are above the purple block. I will lower in a small increment before the final grasp.

arguments.note: I will lower a few millimetres and close gently around the purple block.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The gripper stopped against the purple block rather than closing empty. I will lift it clear to verify the grasp.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The purple block lifted securely. I will carry it above the white block, which will serve as the base.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 10 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The white block is almost centered beneath the held purple block. I will correct slightly sideways and descend while retaining clearance.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The blocks are aligned laterally. I will lower the held block by eight millimetres toward the white block’s top.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will lower another six millimetres to bring the purple block close to its support without releasing it prematurely.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The purple block is aligned immediately above the white block. I will settle it the last few millimetres and open the jaws.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The last 4 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The gripper is open and the purple block remains above the white block. I will lift clear to inspect the stack before collecting the last block.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 9 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: After retreating, the purple block is visibly beside rather than atop the white block. I will regrasp it and correct the fore-aft placement.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 9 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The purple block is centered between the jaws, with the white block just behind it in the wrist view. I will lower above the purple block for a fresh grasp.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will adjust toward the block’s center and close at the same grasp height that previously lifted it securely.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 8 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The purple block is gripped again. I will lift vertically before shifting it toward the center of the white base.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will compensate for the fore-aft offset seen after the first release, moving the purple block farther toward the front of the white base.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 9 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The wrist view now shows the held block too far in front of the base. I will correct toward the midpoint using the observed spacing between the two blocks.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The fore-aft correction is in place. I will approach the base slowly and check the block before releasing.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will release the purple block just above the support at the corrected position, avoiding downward pressure on the stack.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The last 4 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The purple block has been released. I will withdraw straight upward and check whether it remains supported.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 9 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The purple block remains supported on the white block after retreat. I will approach the remaining wooden block to complete the stack.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 10 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The wooden block is slightly right of the wrist center. I will center the jaws and descend above it.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The wooden block is centered laterally. I will make a small fore-aft correction and lower near the grasp height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The wooden block is aligned between the jaws. I will lower a few millimetres and grasp it.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws have closed against the wooden block. I will lift it high enough to clear the two-block stack.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 12 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The wooden block lifted securely. I will carry it above the purple block using the corrected position of the stable two-block stack.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 13 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The wooden block is aligned over the purple block. I will descend to just above the expected contact height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will lower seven millimetres, keeping the wooden block centered above the purple support.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The alignment is unchanged. I will lower another six millimetres toward the top of the stack.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will settle the wooden block the last few millimetres and open the gripper, leaving it on the purple block.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The last 4 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The wooden block is released on the stack. I will lift straight up to clear all three blocks before returning home.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 9 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: All three blocks remain in a stable pile. I will return the right grasp point to its starting position while staying clear of the stack.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 8 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The right arm is back at its starting position. I will restore its original orientation in two stages; the left arm has remained home.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 15 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The three-block stack remains standing. I will finish restoring the right arm’s starting orientation to complete the task.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 16 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.
